data.body: Plan review 2026-10-18 (BLOCK, 1 move), confirmed on origin/main 3fc67e5cd06: AC1's residual-cite allowlist named `legacy_v4_baseline.py:2-6` as a `docs/experiments` docstring cite, but that file's docstring (lines 1-8) cites `docs/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py` and contains no `docs/experiments` string. `git grep -n 'docs/experiments' -- src/rebar/llm/evals` on main returns four hits: `plan_replay/__main__.py:20,21` and `plan_replay/ledger.py:43` (the literals this story deletes) and `plan_replay/corpus.py:5` (a path-only docstring cite that stays). AC1 now says the post-change grep returns exactly that one `corpus.py:5` line, and names the three deleted literals so the implementer can verify the before state too.
